summary.intent: Address all CodeRabbit review comments on PR #202 (fix/e2e-staging-resilience branch), fix a failing CI coverage check, and merge the PR into main.
summary.outcome: All CodeRabbit comments across three rounds were resolved, branch coverage for auth.service.ts was raised from 80.64% to 84.94% (threshold: 84%), a transient CI infra failure was identified and re-run, and the PR was merged.

repo: Rate-limited endpoints use a `@Throttle({ default: { limit: 3, ttl: 60000 } })` decorator from @nestjs/throttler on controller methods.
auth.service.ts injects `PinnedCid` repository and `IPFS_PROVIDER` token — both must be mocked in auth.service.spec.ts TestingModule.
Per-file jest coverage thresholds are defined in apps/api/jest.config.js; auth.service.ts requires 84% branch coverage.
API client is generated from the OpenAPI spec and must be regenerated after controller changes; lint-staged runs prettier on openapi.json automatically.
The monorepo uses pnpm; CI setup has experienced transient npm registry 403 errors unrelated to code changes.
CSS color values in App.css are currently hardcoded (#EF4444, #001a11, #000000) rather than using CSS variables — a known nitpick.

code.finding: deleteAccount endpoint was missing @Throttle decorator and was calling clearCookie before deleteAccount resolved, which logged out users on failure.
deleteAccount method: iterates pinned CIDs, calls unpinFile best-effort, then deletes user. Branches at lines 60, 207-230, 360, 433-434, 437 were uncovered before new tests were added.
mockPinnedCidRepo had an unused `delete` mock — cascade deletion handles removal, so it was never called.
Partial-failure test for deleteAccount needed explicit assertions on unpinFile call count and arguments, not just error handling behavior.

logout() was inside the outer try/catch so a post-deletion logout failure showed 'Failed to delete account' instead of redirecting. Fixed with inner try/catch. setIsDeleting(false) moved to finally block for defensive cleanup.
Fallback redirect after deletion was `/` (a protected route); changed to `/login`.

workflow: CodeRabbit comments appear in multiple rounds — after each push, new comments may appear requiring another pass.
Transient CI failures (npm registry 403 during pnpm setup) should be identified via run logs before assuming a code fix is needed; re-running failed jobs is sufficient.
Resolving GitHub review threads requires both a reply comment and a separate GraphQL `resolveReviewThread` mutation.
Running coverage with --collectCoverageFrom on a single file can give misleading results; the full test suite run is the source of truth for threshold checks.

friction: Multiple Anthropic API 500 internal server errors interrupted the session, requiring the user to prompt 'please keep going' or 'try again' ~8 times.
Coverage threshold failure was only discovered after pushing to CI, not caught locally before the first commit.
The openapi.json lint-staged formatting behavior caused confusion about whether the regenerated spec was actually included in commits.
Fetching GitHub review thread IDs required multiple gh CLI attempts with different GraphQL queries before getting usable output.
open_items: Three CodeRabbit nitpicks intentionally deferred: (1) use @Equals('DELETE') validator in delete-account.dto.ts instead of manual controller check, (2) replace hardcoded CSS colors in App.css with CSS variables, (3) constrain `confirmation` field to enum: ['DELETE'] in openapi.json.
A planning file exists at .planning/quick/022-fix-mfa-status-detection-false-positive/022-PLAN.md suggesting upcoming work on a false-positive MFA status detection bug.
